## 3400 N Central Park Ave — Zoning & Development Analysis
**PIN:** 13-23-316-040-0000 | **Parcel resolution:** authoritative | **Code current through:** Council Journal of March 18, 2026

---

### 1. Zoning District in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RS-3 (Residential Single-Unit)** [4], last map-updated August 27, 2026. There is no recent rezoning on record — the district has not changed by a new ordinance. **Verify:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning)

---

### 2. Can You Build a Two-Flat Here?

**Possibly yes — but only under the Predominance of the Block exemption, not as of right from lot area alone.** The lot is 3,616 sq ft. At RS-3's standard 2,500 sq ft per unit [2], the lot yields only **1 unit** (3,616 ÷ 2,500 = 1.4 → 1 unit). However, this parcel is within the **Predominance of the Block (606) District**, which under [2] allows a two-unit building in RS-3 at a reduced 1,500 sq ft per unit — and 3,616 sq ft ÷ 1,500 = 2.4, so **two units would satisfy the lot-area test**. You would still need to confirm that FAR, height, parking, and lot configuration don't further constrain it (lot area alone is not a guarantee of achievable density [2]).

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards (RS-3)

Per the zoning table for RS-3 ([4], [2]):

| Standard | Value |
|---|---|
| **FAR** | 0.9 |
| **Max Height** | 30 ft |
| **Min Lot Area per Unit** | 2,500 sq ft (standard); 1,500 sq ft for a two-unit building under the 606/Predominance of Block exemption |
| **Min Lot Size** | 2,500 sq ft |
| **Lot Coverage** | Not retrieved from the zoning table |

**Setbacks:** The specific numerical setbacks for RS-3 are not in the retrieved code text — consult [§17-2-0400](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/chicago/latest/chicagozoning_il/) for front, rear, and side setback minimums.

*Note: FAR of 0.9 on 3,616 sq ft = ~3,254 sq ft of total floor area maximum. For a 2-story two-flat this could be a binding constraint — verify before proceeding.*

---

### 4. Overlays & Special Designations

- **Predominance of the Block (606) District** — Applies to this RS-3 parcel ([2]; [§17-7-0591](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/chicago/latest/chicagozoning_il/0-0-0-53035)). Allows a two-unit building at 1,500 sq ft/unit; does not change density for other district types.
- **ADU-Allowed RS Area — Zone 10** — Coach houses and conversion units are permitted by right here, subject to annual and owner-occupancy limits [1].
- **Transit-Oriented Development (CTA)** — This parcel is in a CTA transit-served area (Addison Blue Line, ~0.25 mi). Parking relief applies (see §5 below). No density, FAR, or height bonus applies in RS-3 — those bonuses apply only in dash-3 commercial/residential districts.
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone** — This parcel is in an ARO zone. Residential developments of 10+ units (or certain thresholds) may trigger affordable unit set-aside requirements. The Avondale community area has 6 ARO projects totaling 76 affordable units, including Hairpin Lofts (25 units) and Milwaukee Ave. Apts. (32 units of supportive housing).
- **No Planned Development, landmark/historic district, Special Service Area, or lakefront protection** applies to this parcel.
- **Flood Zone:** FEMA Zone X — minimal flood hazard; flood insurance is not required.
- **Brownfields nearby:** Two BNSF Little Village Paseo segments (EPA IDs 110071982538 & 110071982539) are in the vicinity — environmental due diligence is advisable before breaking ground.

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Relief

Off-street parking for RS districts must be located on the same lot as the dwelling units served [5]. Because this parcel is in a CTA transit-served area, the minimum parking requirement may be reduced by up to **100%** under §17-10-0102-B — meaning parking could potentially be waived entirely. This relief is available without a special entitlement. Note: parking is still prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line [5].

---

### 6. Coach House / Additional Dwelling Unit (ADU)

**Yes — a coach house or conversion unit is permitted by right here**, because the parcel is in ADU-Allowed RS Area — Zone 10 [1], [3]. A building permit for a new coach house in an RS district requires compliance with [1] (§17-7-0570). Key physical limits under [3]:

- Coach house max height: **22 ft** (including rooftop features)
- Must be located in the **rear 30 ft** of lot depth (if in a B/C district — the RS rule references §17-7-0570 compliance)
- At least **3 ft of open space** unobstructed to the sky between the coach house and at least one side property line
- No accessory parking is required to serve the coach house itself
- **Limits that apply here:** Annual limits and owner-occupancy limits per [1] (§17-7-0573, §17-7-0574) — the property owner must occupy one of the units on the lot, and the number of new ADUs citywide per zone per year may be capped. Verify current annual availability with the Department of Housing.

---

### Confidence & What Could Not Be Determined

- **High confidence:** Zoning district (RS-3), FAR (0.9), max height (30 ft), lot area per unit, 606 District applicability, ADU eligibility, parking relief percentage, and flood zone — all from authoritative city GIS and the zoning table.
- **Could not determine:** Specific front/rear/side setback dimensions (not in retrieved code text); assessed value (not available from Cook County at this time); no sales or assessment history was returned. The building currently shows 5 units per assessor records — if that existing nonconforming condition affects redevelopment rights, confirm with CDPD.
- **The existing building** is a 99-year-old (1927), 2-story, 5-unit masonry building with a 3-car garage on a 3,616 sq ft lot. The 5-unit use appears **nonconforming** under RS-3 zoning — an important consideration for any redevelopment or permit work.

*This information is based on official city documents but does not constitute legal advice. Please consult a licensed attorney or contact the relevant city department for official guidance.*
